parts.text: Make the blood dripping from the red CLAYSONS title look realistic: thick glossy wet dark-red blood running down from the bottom edges of the letters in uneven drips of different lengths, some long thin streaks and some fat drops, with shiny highlights, like a horror movie title. Keep the letters CLAYSONS exactly as they are, same font, spelling, size and position. Change nothing else in the image: keep every box, number, word, colour and the black background exactly the same.
